title: Review printed exception diagnostics
why: Printing a caught exception to ordinary output can mix diagnostics with program results and omit traceback or structured logging context.
suggestion: Use appropriate exception logging in reusable code, or send intentional command-line diagnostics explicitly to stderr.
limitations: Only a print call immediately following an exception header is checked; unconditional handler termination is retained as an intentional error boundary.
Direct file=sys.stderr arguments are recognized across multiline calls. String contents, nested calls' file arguments and following print statements do not establish the outer call's output target.
Aliased or dynamically selected streams, custom print replacements, and application-specific logging policy are not resolved.
